column1: AC04: Legacy identifier oracle is captured before mutation.
This is the binding oracle that C2 must reproduce byte-for-byte
The production scanner is at src/lexer.c:873-885 (lexIdentifier).
The oracle in tools/quality/bootstrap02-ident-oracle.c is a
verbatim C99 transcription of that algorithm with the production
by an explicit (src, src_len, start, out_end) ABI.
The algorithm reproduction is byte-exact. The oracle's source
file is included in this ACT's authorized file scope (§25).
SRC_LEN    decimal length of the input
EXP_OK     1 if expected to succeed, 0 otherwise
EXP_END    expected value of *out_end (only meaningful if EXP_OK=1)
EXP_TEXT   expected identifier text (only meaningful if EXP_OK=1)
ACTUAL_OK  observed ok status from the production-oracle run
ACTUAL_END observed out_end from the production-oracle run
The fixture matrix matches ACT §6 I01..I15.
The production-oracle run NEVER mutates src. The oracle
holds src as `const unsigned char *`. This satisfies
AC22 (source immutability) for the oracle itself; the B1
The oracle was built with the host C compiler (cc on this
host) and runs as a standalone executable. It is NOT linked
into hcc and does NOT modify any hcc source.
